newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia 96 gold output seen up to 290 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia 96 gold output seen up to 290 tonnes.

text.p: Australia's gold mines are expected to produce about 290 tonnes of gold in calendar 1996, Melbourne-based mining analysts Surbiton Associates said.
Australian mines produced 73 tonnes of gold in the three months to September 30, taking production for the first nine months of 1996 to 217.5 tonnes.
"September quarter gold production of 73.0 tonnes is the second highest quarterly output ever achieved," said Surbiton managing director Sandra Close.
"Given another good result for the final quarter, Australia will produce around 290 tonnes in calendar 1996," Close said in a statement with Surbiton's Australian Gold Quarterly Review.
This compares with 253.7 tonnes produced in calendar 1995 and 59 tonnes in calendar 1985.
